attributes.title: Focused historical possibility evolution

alignment.basis: Supports DTR and persistent reconsideration under ADR 0038.

horizon.basis: Reuses existing delta projection and exact indexes.

realization.basis: Actual hosted run 46105019766 at exact candidate efbf05ec compared real #1020 history: the authored focus was present on both sides, retained original DEFERRED disposition and appended second DEFERRED rationale, returned the added lesson and relation, and preserved direction on reversal. At limit 1 the focus record matched the full result; both generic and scoped deltas disclosed truncation. At limit 80 the focused result was complete within its one-hop scope. Same-ref returned equal focus records and one unchanged opportunity. Actual #1019 addition returned TARGET_ONLY with directly linked earlier opportunity, and reversal returned BASE_ONLY. Goal/missing focus and missing opt-in flag refused. The generic raw delta was preserved; old/new default and whole-landscape payloads were exactly equal, including workspace context, on one fixed target with warmed shared index cache. Canonical rehearsal verified eight paths, exact bytes, four Python parses and a separate valid three-claim/five-relation proposal.
